Who we are

This Privacy Policy explains how [COMPANY LEGAL NAME] ("LendTrack," "we," "us") collects, uses and shares personal information when you visit lendtrack.io, book a demo call, join our partner program or apply for business funding through a partner's page.

Information we collect

Information you give us. When you request a demo or join the partner program, we collect your name, email, phone number, profession and details about your network. Partners may also give us banking details so we can pay commissions.

Information about business owners. When a business owner applies for funding through a partner's page or is referred to us, we collect business and contact details, funding needs and documents such as bank statements that they choose to provide.

Information collected automatically. We collect device and usage information such as IP address, browser type, pages visited and referring links through cookies, pixels and similar technologies. See our Cookie Policy.

How we use information

  • To respond to demo requests and contact you about the partner program
  • To operate the partner platform, track referrals and pay commissions
  • To evaluate funding requests and connect business owners with lending partners
  • To measure and improve our website and advertising
  • To prevent fraud, keep the platform secure and comply with the law

How we share information

We share personal information only as described here:

  • Lending partners. When a business owner requests funding, we share their application information with lenders and funding providers that may be able to help.
  • Service providers. Companies that help us run our business, such as hosting, email delivery, SMS, scheduling, analytics and payment processing. They may only use the information to provide services to us.
  • Advertising partners. Platforms such as Google and Meta may receive information through cookies and pixels to measure and personalize ads.
  • Legal reasons. When required by law or to protect our rights, users or the public.
  • Business transfers. As part of a merger, acquisition or sale of assets.

We do not sell personal information for money. Some state laws treat sharing data through advertising cookies as a "sale" or "sharing." You can opt out as described below.

Calls, texts and email

If you submit a form with your phone number, you agree that we may contact you by phone, text and email about the partner program, including with automated technology. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to any text to opt out, or use the unsubscribe link in any email.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or get a copy of your personal information, and to opt out of targeted advertising or the "sale" or "sharing" of your information. To make a request, email [PRIVACY@YOURDOMAIN.COM]. We will verify your request and respond as required by law. We won't discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

Data security and retention

We use administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect personal information. No system is completely secure. We keep personal information as long as needed for the purposes above, including to meet legal, accounting and reporting requirements.

Children

Our services are for adults and businesses. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the new version on this page and update the effective date.
